name: Hamed Hassani
title: Associate Professor; Visiting Faculty Researcher at Google Research, NYC
department: Electrical and Systems Engineering (primary); Computer and Information Science; Statistics and Data Science
fitReason: Clear current connection between AI safety methods and real mobile-robot behavior, through context-grounded guardrails for language-based planning. Broader work is primarily learning theory, robustness and optimization.

physicalEvidence.summary: RoboGuard, revised March 3, 2026 and accepted to RA-L in February 2026, integrates an LLM safety module and temporal-logic plan synthesis in a real Clearpath Jackal control loop. Section IV-D and Appendix C-B specify ZED 2 RGB-D, Ouster LiDAR, Nvidia A4000/Ryzen compute, semantic mapping and ROS Move Base. The real-robot evaluation tests safe-task utility and prevention of unsafe plans; the much larger randomized evaluation is simulated and must not be described as all physical. This is collaborative Penn robotics evidence; the sources do not establish a separately owned Hassani robot laboratory.

shortVisit.summary: Official current homepage, faculty listing and CV confirm active Penn appointment and advisees. No explicit current external-master’s short-visit or summer-2027 invitation was located. Google visiting-faculty affiliation does not establish an industry internship route.

scoreReasons.fit: AI robustness and contextual safety synthesis concretely control real robot plan execution, though the broader portfolio is theoretical ML.
scoreReasons.physical: Named actual Jackal experiment verified in primary full text, but collaborative hardware rather than a confirmed Hassani-owned current robot platform.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No applicable personal/lab short-visitor invitation; institutional route alone adds no points.
scoreReasons.freshness: March 2026 primary technical revision, 2026 RA-L acceptance and current official affiliation/CV.
